text: Heb. stammerings of lippe. , 1.Cor.14. 21. , Or, he hath spoken.
Heb. a treading downe to it.
Or, when he shall make you to vnderstand doctrine.
Or, the wheat in the principall place and barley in the appointed place. , Or, spelt. , Heb. border.
Or, and he bindeth it in such sort as God doth teach him.
